column4: A man strumming a slow melancholic folk campfire song on an old slightly out-of-tune acoustic guitar and whistling the melody along with it, alone outdoors in a dark forest at night, a few metres away, crickets faint; no singing
A lone man picking a slow sad folk tune on a battered acoustic guitar and whistling over it, a little off key and too slow, outdoors at night among trees, some distance away; no singing
A hand slapping flat onto the strings of an acoustic guitar to kill the sound dead in the middle of a chord, a short dull thump and silence, outdoors at night
A single steel guitar string being slowly tightened on a creaking wooden tuning peg until it pings, close, quiet, outdoors at night
Heavy boots running fast through wet grass and snapping twigs straight towards the listener, a guitar on a strap knocking and its strings jangling, outdoors at night
A steel guitar string pulled suddenly tight from behind, a twang and a creak of wire under strain, a man's choking gasp very close, horror
A small campfire crackling and popping in the dark forest, a few metres away, quiet night; no voices, no music
